notes: One reference pixel spans 1.00 source pixels. This is a sampling scale, not an independently measured error bound.
status_meaning: pass requires source-pixel consistency and spatial support; not an accuracy guarantee

acceptance.meaning: internal consistency and spatial support; independent check points required for verified accuracy

accuracy_statement: 0.04 source px RMSE over 755 held-out check points (0 of 755 held-out correspondences set aside as isolated mismatches); reference sampling scale 1.00 source px

accuracy.evaluation_basis: all held-out matcher correspondences; not external ground truth

applied_model.sampling: inverse mapping; smoothstep between segment centres

accuracy.source_error_definition: backward transfer in native source pixel centres
accuracy.check_point_rule: held-out correspondence within max(3 reference px, 3 robust sigma) of the median displacement of its 10 nearest held-out neighbours, displacements taken against the coarse model; the exported model is not consulted

independent_ground_truth.independence: asserted by reference author; not inferred from residuals
independent_ground_truth.residual_definition: backward transfer in native source pixel centres; all supplied points

ecc.note: not run: the model was measured at native resolution

accuracy.sampling_floor_basis: nominal one-reference-pixel sampling; not an error lower bound

fine_stage.placement: 49 tiles over 2500 lattice seeds at 20.5 px spacing
fine_stage.patch_selection: spatial cross-validation on common fit-fold probe seeds only

distribution.note: coverage is the fraction of ELIGIBLE reference grid cells holding at least one inlier, where eligible means both images have data there; dispersion is the mean distance from the centroid over the half-diagonal; extrapolation_fraction is the share of eligible cells OUTSIDE the convex hull of the inliers, where the transform is extrapolated rather than interpolated

delivered.basis: verified fit points; uniform cell quota, no relaxation

frame.pixel_convention: zero-based pixel centres; GDAL affine receives centre + 0.5
frame.route: both georeferenced: reference CRS -> source CRS

export.sampling: bilinear original bands, averaged over k x k samples per output pixel where the source is finer; complete inverse registration field
export.radiometry: stored values with original per-band scale and offset
